description: This file defines the CustomShippingQuotesConfiguration class, which extends IntegrationConfiguration and implements CustomIntegrationConfiguration, representing a configuration model for custom shipping quotes including regions and serialization to JSON.

classes.name: CustomShippingQuotesConfiguration
classes.description: A configuration class for custom shipping quotes, including region data and JSON serialization.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the configuration object into a JSON string, including module code, active status, and regions.

methods.name: getModuleCode
methods.description: Returns the module code identifying this shipping configuration.

methods.name: setModuleCode
methods.description: Sets the module code for this configuration.

methods.name: getRegions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of regions associated with this shipping configuration.

methods.name: setRegions
methods.description: Sets the list of regions associated with this shipping configuration.
